_comment: Content pack: the third star system, Thessaly Drift, two jumps out (Halvane > Kovar > Thessaly). Merged into content.json by Data.merge_pack at load; only ids that do not exist yet are added, so loading twice (or a content.json that already has them) changes nothing. A surface with 'from' clones that surface and applies the overrides; 'strip_estates' removes the estate doors and 'strip_contacts' the story contacts of the clone.

thessaly.name: Thessaly Drift
thessaly.desc: Far end of the Kovar lane. One walled arcology that pays top credits and polices every pocket, and one lawless moon where nobody counts.

kovar_thessaly_gate.name: Thessaly Jump Gate
kovar_thessaly_gate.desc: Long-haul gate. Deep lane, so the toll is steeper and the trip takes longer.

thessaly_gate.name: Kovar Jump Gate
thessaly_gate.desc: The way back to the Kovar Expanse.

quillon.name: Quillon
quillon.desc: Walled arcology world. Wealthy buyers pay for coke and fentanyl, scanners hum on every street.

ashfall.name: Ashfall
ashfall.desc: Burnt-out moon, no law since the last warden left. Raw cheap, meth sells high, the fence takes everything.

officials.name: Inspector Odalys Wren
officials.bio: Files every scan twice. Her second copy is the one that goes missing for a fee.

officials.name: Customs Chief Tobiah Kasimir
officials.bio: Runs the strictest scanner on the lane. Everybody has a price, his is just high.

officials.name: Captain Dessa Marl
officials.bio: Commands three cutters and nobody who cares. Takes payment in anything that burns.
